expected_effect: Increased malignant_recall (target > 0.95) at the potential cost of slightly reduced balanced_accuracy due to increased false positives.

proposed_changes.justification: Round 1 malignant_recall is 0.9286, which is below the target of 0.95. Lowering the decision threshold from 0.5 to 0.4 increases sensitivity for the positive class (malignant), aiming to push malignant_recall above the 0.95 target while remaining within the allowed_revision_policy.
